config.price_rule: decision price = bar OPEN at bar indices floor(B*j/k) of each day; final point = close of last bar of day 5; S normalised by S0 = first open
config.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap, block length = round(n^(1/3))
config.saturated_rule: CVaR gain from previous frequency < its block-bootstrap SE, or negative

provenance.xi0_formula: xi0 = mean_t (VIX_close_t / 100)^2 over all dates in ^GSPC_1d intersect ^VIX_1d (annualised variance)
provenance.trained_on: calibrated simulated rough-Bergomi paths (never on the real test windows)
